    • reproducesEquilibrium

      private static boolean reproducesEquilibrium(SystemInterface reference, double temperature, double pressure)
      Re-solve the hydrate equilibrium condition from a clean phase split at the converged temperature.

      The iteration re-uses the phase split of the previous step, so a flash that degenerates part way through the search can leave the system in a state where the water fugacity equality is satisfied by an artefact rather than by a real three phase equilibrium. Repeating the check on an untouched copy of the feed rejects such roots: a real equilibrium temperature reproduces the residual, an artefact does not.

      Parameters:
      reference - an untouched copy of the feed
      temperature - the converged temperature in Kelvin
      pressure - the pressure in bara
      Returns:
      true when the equilibrium condition is reproduced from a clean phase split

    • hasUnstableAqueousGuestPhase

      private static boolean hasUnstableAqueousGuestPhase(SystemInterface target)
      Reject a single aqueous brine that can lower its Gibbs energy by releasing a hydrate-guest vapour.

      A failed stability search can leave all CO2 dissolved in an otherwise balanced aqueous phase. Its inflated guest fugacity can satisfy the hydrate residual above the fresh-water boundary. A negative tangent-plane distance for a guest-only gas trial proves that the aqueous state is unstable. A non-negative value is only a screening result, not a complete stability certificate.

      Parameters:
      target - fluid after the verification TP flash
      Returns:
      true when a guest vapour destabilizes the single aqueous brine or its fugacity cannot be evaluated

    • hasIonsInAGasPhase

      private static boolean hasIonsInAGasPhase(SystemInterface target)
      Check whether a phase split has placed ions in a phase identified as gas.

      Ions are not volatile, so a gas phase carrying a material ion fraction means the phase identification has failed. Densities, activities and fugacities of that phase are then evaluated on the wrong volume root, and any hydrate temperature built on it is an artefact rather than an equilibrium.

      Parameters:
      target - the system to inspect
      Returns:
      true when a gas phase carries a material amount of ions
